text_block_list.text: I ran so much today, I could eat a cow!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Do you want to have a bit of my food,
Spe?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Yeah. I don't need that much.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Giving me your own food... You must be
some
kind of angel, Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Now, don't mind if I do!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. No one looks happier when
they're eating
than you, Spe.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
And so, Suzuka manages to stick to her
diet
without having to try very hard at
all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
